_what: The words the sign-in pages' script may show: failed, unavailable, not_sent, too_many and email_needed from the sign-in words the pages were drawn with; key_made is the key page's own; the rest are the connect pages' (consent, device, approve). `scopes` says in plain words what each OAuth scope lets an AI do (a scope not listed is shown as its own name); `kinds` names the kinds of row in a root declaration (a kind not listed is shown as its own name).
failed: That did not work. Try again.
unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
not_sent: The code could not be sent just now, so none is on its way. Try again in a minute.
too_many: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
email_needed: Type the email address you sign in with.
key_made: Your key is made and copied. Keep it now: it is shown only once.
code_wrong: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
code_expired: That code ran out. Start again on your device.
root_mismatch: This change is not the one that was asked for, so it was not shown for approval.
root_missing: This change could not be found.
approve_failed: The passkey was not used, so nothing was approved.

scopes.offline_access: Stay connected until you take it away
scopes.records: Read and change what you keep in Trillion
scopes.account: See your account and your computers
scopes.vault: Use the logins and keys you keep

kinds.way: a way to reach a computer
